lede: Four positions since Jul 2025: three machine learning research roles in Spain and Switzerland, and one machine learning and backend engineering role at Wembley Studios.
skillsLede: Programming languages, machine learning libraries, engineering tools and methods, plus spoken languages.

roles.title: Junior Machine Learning Researcher
highlights: Research and benchmark Transformer-based architectures for financial and tabular data.
Build reproducible PyTorch training and evaluation pipelines with leakage-safe splits, ablation studies and documented results, supporting the group’s research and technology-transfer projects.
Run local large language model inference with Ollama, profiling memory and compute bottlenecks to size hardware for research workloads.

roles.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
highlights: Investigated NLP methodologies and Transformer-based large language models to advance the SOFIA scientific initiative, surveying the literature and prototyping the most promising approaches.
Reconstructed state-of-the-art deep learning architectures from academic papers into functional, documented PyTorch codebases, validating each reproduction against reported results.

roles.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant
highlights: Reimplemented the TRACE paper (arXiv:2409.12972) in PyTorch, engineering Transformer encoder models over clickstream event sequences for user recommendation — github.com/Fasmanuel2002/AAI_HSLU_TRACE.
Built Big Data preprocessing pipelines converting raw clickstream event logs into model-ready training sequences.
Benchmarked the reproduction against published baselines and documented architecture ablations for the lab.
